profile.headline: Software Engineer
profile.geoLocationName: New York, New York, United States
profile.summary:
I am a New York–based software engineer looking to continuously grow and evolve in this constantly changing world of technology.

I specialize in front-end development with professional experience in React, TypeScript, and Tailwind CSS. However, I am also open to roles in back-end, full-stack, and mobile development, with experience in technologies that include but are not limited to: Python, C#, Ruby on Rails, PostgreSQL, and SwiftUI.

Personally, I like to build tools that automate tasks and improve my day-to-day productivity — anything from playlist organizers to local budgeting apps. Feel free to explore my portfolio for a look at past projects and see what I'm currently working on.

Lets connect!

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Built a client portal in-tandem with an offshore engineering team under a Scrum methodology. Developed in TypeScript/React with a Ruby on Rails and PostgreSQL API to serve as a proxy for managing Salesforce data
- Transformed InVision designs into responsive web pages. Utilized React hooks, contexts, and Tailwind CSS components for state management and rapid UI/UX development
- Implemented Test-Driven Development (TDD), enforcing a 95% test coverage to improve code reliability and reduce debugging tasks
- Collaborated cross-functionally using Jira, reinforcing Agile principles to improve backlog management, minimize blockers, and ensure timely feature delivery
- Eliminated code redundancy through pair programming sessions, adhering to SOLID Principles and Design Patterns
positions.insights: Skills: React.js · TypeScript · Tailwind CSS · Scrum · Agile · Ruby on Rails · GitHub

projects.title: Barkada
projects.description:
Full-stack application for managing friends and tracking social media groups (close friends, favorites, etc.)

• Utilized Tailwind UI components for faster front-end development with TypeScript and React
• Created a REST API with Express, Prisma, and PostgreSQL, all containerized using Docker Compose
• Performed integration tests using Postman for API reliability and functionality

projects.title: Spodupy
projects.description:
Python CLI tool for detecting duplicate tracks in Spotify playlists using ISRC-based matching

• Packaged for local installation with pip
